goal: Fail on startup when a single-value setting is assigned multiple times in a config file
Prevent node operators from unknowingly running with silently discarded configuration settings
agreement: Concept approval because intentionally repeatable settings get a new flag (JeremyRubin)
Concern that existing configs in the wild will cause nodes to fail to restart on upgrade (ajtowns)
Approval from an account with no project history and no stated reason (Khailand69)
